event: Half-blind with afterglow, Nala reaches into the weir stone with earth, two workings at once.

memory.fact: A spike costs 20 mana; twin spikes are two workings at 40, one act, one roll, landing as two hits.

event: The apron cracks under the blur; two stone spikes thrust up, angled back toward the mill.

changes.note: Twin stone spikes are two workings at 40 mana

memory.fact: Nala can thrust a stone surface up into spikes within her reach, in about a second.
Earth can thrust stone up as spikes within a held working's reach in about a second; a Surge use.
Nala's spikes rise before the wyrm, its stun just ending, can reach the water.

event: They punch through the Wyrm's pale belly and stand out of its back, pinning it to the ledge.

memory.fact: A beast run through by stone spikes is pinned on them and cannot flee while it lives.
The wyrm's back scales are a 2-point ward; its pale belly and throat have none.

event: The long body bucks once on the spikes, thrashes, and goes slack, its tail a yard from the water.

changes.note: The spikes run the Weir Wyrm through, belly to back, and kill it
The Level 18 wyrm earns her 3 marks toward Level 11

memory.fact: At 11:37 on day 8 Nala's stone spikes ran the Weir Wyrm through, belly to back, and killed it.

event: Nala's sight clears. She looses a beam from her palm into the scorched head, and it burns on.

changes.note: A palm beam into the dead wyrm's head costs 20 mana

event: The Wyrm hangs on the stone spikes, still, the pool lapping a yard below its tail.

memory.fact: The dead wyrm hangs pinned on the spikes on the apron's east third, its tail a yard from the water.

event: Up at Hobb's landing, Jory Pell lets out a whoop that carries over the roar of the weir.

changes.note: The barge crews saw her lightning and spikes end the wyrm; word will go down the river

memory.fact: Seeing the wyrm die, Jory Pell whoops from Hobb's landing.
